title: Forensics Lab: Data Breach
briefing: Cyber forensics extracted raw device telemetry from compromised banking terminals using Pandas. Identify rogue device IDs matching format DEV-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4} involved in unauthorized EXFIL actions. Filter out benign SYS- servers and malformed device tags.
